workflows.name: LP-00 Setup and Seed
workflows.purpose: One-click provisioning: Odoo connection, external-ref field, funnel stages, seed agents.

workflows.name: LP-01 Intake
workflows.purpose: Website, WhatsApp and CSV intake: normalize to one schema, gate duplicate deliveries, quarantine bad rows, hand off.

workflows.name: LP-02 Qualify
workflows.purpose: Enrichment, deterministic scoring, independent AI classification, conflict detection, band decision.

workflows.name: LP-03 Route and Sync
workflows.purpose: Duplicate resolution, workload-aware assignment, idempotent Odoo upsert, stage transition, follow-up scheduling, outreach.

workflows.name: LP-04 Tick
workflows.purpose: Drains the follow-up and SLA queue, requeues stuck work, dead-letters stale CRM claims, reassigns orphaned leads.

workflows.name: LP-05 Error Handler and DLQ
workflows.purpose: Catch every workflow failure, classify it, dead-letter it, alert when useful, and replay it safely.

workflows.name: LP-06 Events and Approvals
workflows.purpose: Reply, opt-out, booking, close and sales-action events, plus the VIP approve/reject decision.

workflows.name: LP-07 Ops Report
workflows.purpose: Daily operational summary and an on-demand JSON metrics endpoint over the audit, lead, job and dead-letter tables.

workflows.name: LP-90 Odoo Gateway
workflows.purpose: Single egress point for Odoo. Auth, retry with bounded backoff, and the 200-on-error trap.

workflows.name: LP-92 Send Message
workflows.purpose: Single outbound gate: idempotent claim, last-moment stop-condition recheck, email or WhatsApp, recorded result.

workflows.name: LP-99 Mock Services
workflows.purpose: Enrichment, WhatsApp and booking stand-ins, with on-demand deterministic failure injection.
